title: A GPH-Filtered Hannan--Rissanen Information Criterion for ARFIMA Order Selection
summary: We propose a simple two-stage order selector for finite-order ARFIMA models. First, a preliminary log-periodogram estimate of the memory parameter is used to fractionally filter the data. Second, a Hannan--Rissanen residual construction is applied to the filtered series, and the autoregressive and moving-average orders are selected by a generalized information criterion over a growing candidate rectangle.
